en: The postcard features a black and white photograph of a historic site with a large, elegant building surrounded by lush trees, garden structures, and a curved pathway. The architecture and park setting suggest a palatial estate. On the back, there is a handwritten message in German, a green postage stamp from the 'Deutsches Reich', and the address is written in old-style script. There is also a purple stamp from 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.' The caption on the photograph reads 'Bad Pyrmont. Fürstliches Schloß.'
